description: This file contains the implementation of a LocalDataStore class that manages persistent storage of Task objects using SharedPreferences, including methods to load and save tasks represented as JSON.

classes.name: LocalDataStore
classes.description: A class that provides persistent storage for Task objects, saving and loading them as JSON arrays within SharedPreferences.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a list of Task objects from SharedPreferences, parsing the stored JSON array.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a list of Task objects into SharedPreferences as a JSON array.

methods.name: Task.toJson
methods.description: Converts a Task object into a JSONObject for storage.

methods.name: JSONObject.toTask
methods.description: Constructs a Task object from a JSONObject.
